The Oracle's Awakening: My Ex-Husband Begs for Mercy

Chandler, the arrogant Sun God, discards his wife Tracy, unknowingly destroying the realm she sustained as the legendary Origin Rune Master "Z." Cursed and dying, she's rescued by Sean, the terrifying Lord of the Abyss, who has hunted her for a century.

The hook: The underestimated lead collects every debt, one episode at a time.
